description:
Use this when the user wants a clip's file or to open it in the full editor: "send me the clip", "let me
edit this one". Returns download_url, a private link for five minutes (keep it private; call again for a
fresh one), and editor_url.
Not for: watching in the chat (show_clips) or a still (preview_frame). Free.

clip_id.description: Clip id from list_clips or a finished job; a photo id also works
